fields.summary_ko.0: Micron (NASDAQ: MU) rose 154% year-to-date but has declined over 40% since the June peak, increasing uncertainty around 2027 year-end price forecasts.
fields.summary_ko.1: Fiscal 2026 revenue reached $133.19 billion (+256% YoY) and non-GAAP EPS achieved $75.52 (+811% YoY), though concerns persist regarding price declines once memory shortages ease and impacts from AI policy regulation changes.
